name: pilates machine lying frog and leg circle
description: Reformer leg work: frog press followed by circles. It trains the hips and inner thighs with control.
instructions: Lie on the reformer with your feet in the straps or on the bar.
Bend your knees and open them out, heels together, in a frog shape.
Circle them out, around and back together.
Reverse the circle direction after a few reps.
Keep your back steady on the pad.
